## Estate Health

- [ ] Run lint, tests, doctor, and dashboard generation.
- [ ] Review duplicate, orphan, and rights gaps.
- [ ] Check MCP install on active machines.

## Asset Ops

- [ ] Clear mobile inbox.
- [ ] Curate Eagle/Drive inbox.
- [ ] Record any website, social, or publication usage.
- [ ] Review music release proof folders with Music IS as canonical.

## Product Ops

- [ ] Move one issue into active work.
- [ ] Close or update completed tasks.
- [ ] Update docs/PROJECT_BOARD.md if priorities changed.
- [ ] Note a market or product learning.

## Risks

- [ ] Any private asset exposure?
- [ ] Any sync conflict?
- [ ] Any adapter credential or terms risk?
